以详细列表显示文件: Show files in a detailed list

输入路径或远程地址: Enter a path or remote address

将当前文件夹加入侧栏: Add the current folder to the sidebar
连接到 FTP、SFTP、SMB 或 WebDAV: Connect to FTP, SFTP, SMB or WebDAV
有秩序的文件管理 · Linux 优先，同时兼容 macOS 与 Windows: Orderly file management · Linux-first, with macOS and Windows compatibility
· 多标签页与可拖拽分屏: · Multi-tab browsing and draggable split panes
· 跨文件系统复制、移动与传输队列: · Cross-file-system copy, move, and transfer queue
· zip / tar / tar.gz 压缩与解压: · zip / tar / tar.gz compression and extraction
· 命令面板与完整键盘操作: · Command palette and full keyboard operation
Ordoa 取自 Ordo（秩序）加上 Avalonia 的 A。安序希望用克制: Ordoa comes from Ordo (order) plus the A of Avalonia. Ordoa aims for a restrained, clear interface that keeps everyday file operations close at hand and advanced capabilities within reach when needed.
Ordoa 是一个开源项目。图标、界面与代码均可自由修改。远程连接密码优先保存在: Ordoa is an open-source project. Icons, UI, and code are freely modifiable. Remote passwords are stored in the system keyring (libsecret / Keychain) when available, otherwise in a config file readable only by the current user.
输入八进制权限，例如 755、644、700。修改会立即生效。: Enter octal permissions, e.g. 755, 644, 700. Changes apply immediately.
统计文件夹中的文件数量与总大小: Count files and total size in the folder
对文件内容计算 SHA-256 摘要，用于校验完整性: Compute a SHA-256 digest of the file contents to verify integrity

两者都是文件夹。替换会先删除目标文件夹再复制，保留两者会使用新的名称。: Both are folders. Replace deletes the destination folder before copying; Keep Both uses a new name.
SMB 使用 TCP 445 端口；端口设置不会改变实际连接端口。: SMB uses TCP port 445; changing the port does not affect the actual connection.
